beats.subline: Thursday, November 19, 2026 close — a broad AI-stock selloff dragged the S&P 500 to a sixth straight loss despite strong demand for Anthropic's Wall Street debut.
beats.body: More than 90% of S&P 500 stocks fell as AI-bubble worries deepened, pulling the index to its longest losing streak since 2024 and 8.2% below last month's record even as Anthropic's ANT shares drew strong investor interest on their Nasdaq debut; the Dow closed below 50,000 for the first time since June, and all three indexes are down 5-6% for the week.

beats.headline: Hegseth signs deal to restore US-Venezuela military ties in surprise Caracas visit
beats.body: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth made an unannounced trip to Caracas and signed an agreement with acting President Delcy Rodriguez to resume joint training, intelligence sharing and defense-equipment cooperation aimed at narco-terrorist groups, less than a year after a US operation captured Nicolas Maduro; Hegseth said expanded US access to Venezuelan oil also makes the Strait of Hormuz 'a non-factor for the Western Hemisphere.'

beats.headline: Xi warns Trump against 'great turbulence' over Taiwan during historic Shenzhen summit
beats.body: Meeting Trump privately before their trilateral sit-down with Putin, Xi Jinping said the US must keep 'doing the right thing' on Taiwan to avoid igniting 'great turbulence' in the relationship, echoing a May warning that mishandling the issue could lead to conflict; Beijing has pressed Washington to drop a congressionally approved $14 billion Taiwan arms package that Trump has called a possible 'negotiating chip.'

beats.headline: Anthropic shares give back most of debut-day gains in second day of trading
beats.body: ANT fell as much as 13% intraday Friday, erasing most of Thursday's 17% pop above its $83 IPO price, as investors took profits across the AI trade; Nvidia, AMD and Micron each dropped more than 7% in the same broad selloff, which pushed the Nasdaq down roughly 3% on the day.

beats.headline: Kyler Gordon sidelined, Jeffery Simmons limited as Bears prep for Saints
beats.body: Cornerback Kyler Gordon did not practice Wednesday with a shoulder injury coach Ben Johnson called 'day-to-day,' while defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons was limited with a knee issue after sitting out Tuesday; receiver Luther Burden has cleared the concussion protocol with no injury designation ahead of Sunday's home game against the Saints.
